multiGenerate_trap.finding: 268 of 1,243 TXs (21.6%) were pure multiGenerate() calls — ALL wasted gas.
multiGenerate_trap.explanation: multiGenerate() calls AFFECTION.Generate() which mints AFF to the AFFECTION contract itself via _mintToCap(). The minted AFF is NOT transferred to the caller. Only multiBuyWith() delivers AFF to msg.sender.
